title: Reproducing Akinwande, Ho and Plummer 1982: fixed charge under argon anneals and thermal cycling

sample.paper: “Oxides were grown on (111) and (100) Si Cz wafers” (cycling); Figure 5 says (100)
sample.ours: FAMILY: Si_Planar; ORIENTATION: Si100 | Si111; GROWTH: Cz (recorded, read by nothing)
sample.note: Czochralski is stated for the cycling wafers only. The authors list a CZ against FZ repeat as an open question (p. 51).

sample.paper: “20 min pre heat in Argon …, 20 min 1% HCl/Ar etch + 20 min purge in Argon at 1000° C”; Figure 5: “insitu HCl Clean”
sample.ours: CLEAN: HCl_in_situ, and three RUNs in argon
sample.note: No wet clean is described. The HCl cannot be written in a gas mixture.

sample.paper: 75 min dry O2 at 1000 °C; thickness not stated
sample.ours: grown by the history: 65.6 nm by the 1965 law
sample.note: No program reads the thickness for charge; the charge program starts from the steady value for 1000 °C.

sample.paper: not stated; “POST METALLIZATION FGA” on Figures 6, 7

history.paper: not stated; the furnace of Figure 4 has argon, HCl, nitrogen and oxygen inlets and a nitrogen flush at the mouth
“They were subjected to 20 min pre heat in Argon prior to oxidation”
history.ours: RUN PreHeat DURATION 1200 TEMP 1000->1000 AMBIENT inert_Ar
history.note: Stated for the cycling wafers (p. 49). For the time-series wafers Figure 5 says only “insitu HCl Clean”; we give them the same sequence.

history.item: In-situ etch in 1% HCl in argon, 20 min
history.paper: “20 min 1% HCl/Ar etch + 20 min purge in Argon at 1000° C”
history.ours: RUN HClEtch DURATION 1200 TEMP 1000->1000 AMBIENT inert_Ar
history.note: The language's mixtures take O2, N2, H2, H2O and Ar only, so the 1% HCl cannot be written; the step is argon and the sample's CLEAN: HCl_in_situ records the etch. No program reads either.

history.paper: “+ 20 min purge in Argon at 1000° C”
history.ours: RUN Purge DURATION 1200 TEMP 1000->1000 AMBIENT inert_Ar

history.paper: “oxides were grown at 1000° C in dry O2 for 75 mins”
history.ours: RUN Oxidation DURATION 4500 TEMP 1000->1000 AMBIENT dry_O2
history.note: The water content of the oxygen and the oxide thickness are not stated.

history.paper: “were fast pulled (~ 2 sec pull)”; “pull times of < 3 secs have generally been achieved”
history.ours: RUN Pull DURATION 2 TEMP 1000->400 AMBIENT dry_O2
history.note: The time is the report's. The end temperature (400 °C) and the gas are ours: the wafer is pulled “from the oxidizing ambient” into a mouth flushed with nitrogen (Figure 4); how it cools after that is not stated.

history.paper: “POST METALLIZATION FGA” (Figures 6 and 7); metal, method and temperature not stated

history.ours: RUN FGA DURATION 1800 TEMP 400->400 AMBIENT forming_gas_H2
history.note: Stated on Figures 6 and 7, which show the same oxidation and anneals, and not on Figure 5, whose values we compare. Temperature, time and composition are not given. The fixed-charge program leaves hydrogen steps out, so no choice here changes the compared number.
